g.text: Observed (unsuppressed) prescriptions per 1,000 enrollees; dark outline = active Medicaid coverage; grey = no
In 2025 Q3 states with active coverage filled 37.0 Wegovy and Zepbound prescriptions per
Source: CMS State Drug Utilization Data and Medicaid enrollment. Observed counts only: cells under 11 are suppressed, so rates are
lower bounds. 2025 Q3 is the last full quarter before the preliminary 2026 Q1 data.
